title: Component invertibility of closure refinement

source.place: Finite-coefficient descent for the closure refinement; Bhatt--Scholze 6.8.14--6.8.15

proof.text: Choose a finite coefficient field through which the bounded constructible object and its refinement data descend. The finite proper/open mate is invertible by the finite comparison, and the filtered finite-field colimit and exact scalar extension transport this inverse to the displayed component over the finite-valued algebraic closure.
